extract_vinvl_features: run the FeatureExtractor to extract VinVL image features from a directory of images and save as npy files
build_detection_model: build the AttrRCNN detection model with VinVL X-152-C4 config and weights for feature extraction
get_vinvl_features: get VinVL features from a list of image paths using the AttrRCNN detection model
process_feature_extraction: process AttrRCNN object detection output and image sizes into normalized image features and info dicts
save_feature: save extracted image features and metadata as numpy files to the configured output folder
